english.note: Use 淹沒 as the all-purpose choice when someone or something is figuratively overwhelmed or literally submerged.
Use this for being submerged or inundated by water or, more figuratively, by a mass of things; it is less conversational than the other choice.

examples.english: Huge waves can engulf the whole beach.
examples.traditional: 大浪可以淹沒成個海灘。
examples.jyutping: daai6 long6 ho2 ji5 jim1 mut6 sing4 go3 hoi2 taan1

examples.english: Floodwaters could drown coastal villages, forcing residents to evacuate.
examples.traditional: 洪水淹沒沿岸村落，居民被迫撤離。
examples.jyutping: hung4 seoi2 jim1 mut6 jyun4 ngon6 cyun1 lok6 geoi1 man4 bei6 bik1 cit3 lei4
